candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: RAF inhibitors differentially affect BRAF-CRAF heterodimerization as tested by recombinant protein dimerization assay
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment tested whether RAF priming is mediated by the inhibitors' conformational effects on the RAF kinase domain and is similar to what was reported in Figure 4A of [12] and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report [2].
candidates.notes: Authors explicitly state they were unable to conduct the experiment as planned; BRAF bound to Protein-A-agarose beads independently of CRAF, preventing assessment of the original finding about inhibitor-dependent modulation of BRAF-CRAF heterodimerization. Experiment could not be completed as planned due to antibody and bead-binding technical issues; the authors state the data were 'unable to address whether, under the conditions of the original study, the same observations could be observed'

candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment was comparable to what was reported in Figure 1A of [12] and described in Protocol 1 in the Registered Report [2].

candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: Knockdown of CRAF, but not BRAF, attenuates phospho-MEK induction after RAF inhibitor treatment in wild-type RAF cells
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 2B of [12] and described in Protocol 2 in the Registered Report [2].
candidates.notes: PLX4720 results were in the same direction as the original (success), but GDC-0879 results were not in the same direction and not statistically significant where predicted (failure); overall inconclusive due to mixed results across the two drug scenarios within the same experiment [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: The CRAF kinase domain forms a stable complex with wild-type BRAF, with PLX4720 destabilizing and GDC-0879 stabilizing the interaction, while these inhibitors do not alter the interaction with BRAF(V600E).
candidates.citation_sentence: The BRAF and CRAF antibodies reported in the original study (Hatzivassiliou et al., 2010) were tested for suitability by Western blot.
candidates.notes: The replication could not validly assess BRAF-CRAF heterodimerization because BRAF bound directly to the affinity beads in the absence of CRAF; the authors explicitly state that the data were unable to address whether the original observations could be reproduced.

candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: RAF inhibitors selectively inhibit proliferation of BRAF(V600E) cancer cells but not wild-type RAF/RAS or mutant RAS cells, whereas the MEK inhibitor inhibits proliferation across these cell types.
candidates.citation_sentence: Absolute EC50 values for each biological repeat for A375, HCT116, and MeWo cells treated with (A) PLX4720, (B) GDC-0879, or (C) PD0325901 for this replication attempt are plotted with the EC50 value reported in Hatzivassiliou et al. (2010) displayed as a single point (red triangle) for comparison.
candidates.notes: The replication authors state that the results were in the same direction as the original study. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: PLX4720-induced phospho-MEK activation in mutant RAS cells depends on CRAF depletion but not BRAF depletion.
candidates.citation_sentence: Data estimated from the representative experiment reported in Figure 2B of Hatzivassiliou et al., 2010 is displayed as a single point (red triangle) for comparison.
candidates.notes: The replication found CRAF-dependent attenuation of phospho-MEK induction after PLX4720 treatment, with a statistically significant planned comparison. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
candidates.description: GDC-0879-induced phospho-MEK activation in mutant RAS cells depends on CRAF depletion but not BRAF depletion.
candidates.citation_sentence: Data estimated from the representative experiment reported in Figure 2B of Hatzivassiliou et al., 2010 is displayed as a single point (red triangle) for comparison.
candidates.notes: The replication did not reproduce the original CRAF-dependent pattern: the BRAF comparison was significant in the opposite pattern and the CRAF comparison was not significant. The authors note that unexpected baseline differences between the independently generated shRNA cell lines confound interpretation. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
